items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Paul Banks--have you ever heard of Gene Cory and the Black Aces?

ctx.x: what, I would say from 1926 to 1937 I really became very much involved in music, and at that time I had the chance to hear some of the greatest. Believe it or not, if you come to think about it, some of the greatest musicians that we have in America, came from the Dallas, Oklahoma City, Tulsa and Kansas City area, and even Little Rock. That's where the Southern Serenaders hailed from.
Along about that time, Chauncy Downs from Kansas City would come in with his band ; Paul Banks--have you ever heard of Gene Cory and the Black Aces?
